title: Frontiers: Virus Shook the Streaming Star: Estimating the COVID-19 Impact on Music Consumption
near_miss_reason: time-varying controls (COVID cases and deaths per million) in every Table 3 column, plus extra FE (country x week-of-year and country x year)
eligible_reason: Table 2 (main) is a year-over-year DiD with a common date: treated = 2020 period, after = week_of_period >= 41 (early March), so it has one cohort. Table 3 regresses log streams on each binary country-level lockdown policy, one per column. Each policy has 6-10 adoption weeks across 60 countries. Every column also includes cases_per_million and deaths_per_million and absorbs country x treated and country x week_of_period in addition to week, so no column qualifies. Table 4 enters all eight policies at once with mobility measures (multiple treatments and continuous regressors).
design_notes: Country-week panel (60 countries x 104 weeks, 2018-06-01 to 2020-05-22; weeks 1-52 = 2018-19 placebo year with all policy dummies 0, weeks 53-104 = 2019-20). Table 2: reghdfe ln_num_streams treated after c.treated#c.after with three FE sets. Table 3: reghdfe ln_num_streams d_restrict_X cases_per_million deaths_per_million, absorb(country_index country_index#treated country_index#week_of_period week) vce(cluster country_index). Policies are binarized OxCGRT ordinal indicators; some switch off (e.g., stay-at-home: 20 countries switch off at least once).
n_eligible_specs_note: The 8 Table 3 policy columns are the staggered binary specifications, but all include time-varying controls and country x week-of-year FE. They are recorded as near-miss specs.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Distinct first-adoption weeks by policy (computed from Dataset.dta): school 8, workplace 8, events 7, gatherings 8, transport 6, stay-at-home 8, internal movement 9, international travel 10. All 60 countries adopt every policy by May 2020 (no never-treated country within the 2020 period; the 2019 placebo-year weeks are untreated for everyone).
modern_estimator_note: Cites Bertrand, Duflo and Mullainathan (2004) per candidate flags; code uses reghdfe only.

specs.treatment_definition: Binary OxCGRT school closing indicator by country-week; 0 in all 2019 weeks; switches on between weeks 86 and 101 (Feb to May 2020).
specs.fe: country_index + country_index#treated (country x year) + country_index#week_of_period (country x week-of-year) + week
specs.notes: Excluded: time-varying COVID case and death controls in every column, plus country x week-of-year and country x year FE (prior-year baseline), which are additional non-redundant FE.
